entries.title: A task split into parts shows what its parts are doing
entries.body: A task whose parts do its work no longer reads Backlog while those parts move. Its status follows its busiest open part: Waiting on you while a part's card waits, Working while a part works. It shows on its record, in Tasks, on the board and on your iPhone.

picture.alt: A task's record whose status reads Waiting on you because one of its two open parts has a card waiting.
